SplitRight.note: CLI chooses terminal or app explicitly; the shortcut mirrors the focused pane type.

SplitDown.note: CLI chooses terminal or app explicitly; the shortcut mirrors the focused pane type.

Navigate.note: Select the destination by pane id rather than relative direction.

SwitchContext.note: CLI uses a stable context id rather than the sidebar index.

NextTab.note: Select the destination by pane id rather than tab order.

PrevTab.note: Select the destination by pane id rather than tab order.

NextContext.note: Select the destination by context id rather than sidebar order.

PrevContext.note: Select the destination by context id rather than sidebar order.

OpenQuickNote.note: CLI supplies text directly instead of opening the entry overlay.

ForceReloadApp.ui-only: Developer recovery gesture for a focused app; normal source edits reload through the file watcher.

NavBackApp.note: CLI traverses host focus history; app-local navigation remains owned by each app.

HidePane.note: Use pane reveal to restore visibility; the shortcut toggles.

ParkContext.note: Use context unpark to restore and focus; the shortcut toggles.

OpenNotesPicker.note: CLI opens its terminal picker instead of the desktop overlay.

CloseContext.note: Honors desktop confirmation; response reports pending_confirmation.

MoveContextUp.ui-only: Sidebar ordering is a visual preference; contexts remain addressable by stable id.

MoveContextDown.ui-only: Sidebar ordering is a visual preference; contexts remain addressable by stable id.

ToggleShortcuts.ui-only: Displays the keyboard reference overlay; agents use CLI help.

ToggleCommandPalette.ui-only: Displays a human command chooser; agents invoke the selected command directly.

ScrollUp.ui-only: Moves the visible viewport; agents read pane capture output.

ScrollDown.ui-only: Moves the visible viewport; agents read pane capture output.

ToggleNotificationModal.ui-only: Opens the desktop notification viewer; agents inspect needs-you and notification records.

SendPane.ui-only: Focus-preserving spatial layout gesture; pane swap exposes the corresponding layout move with focus following.
